items.note: The front page opens on a full yolk band with a sag arc, a 64px-class bold tight headline, a blue pill paired with a white on-field pill on their ledges, and a vignette of white product cards overlapping on the band with a crescent-shaded disc, sparkle and cloud. Below come a cream featured card, a confetti-opened 'more posts' heading, ink and cream filter pills with the dot, and borderless cream cards with full-hue covers. It reads as the reference's 01/02 language. The hero confetti is a little thinner than 02's layered scene.

The hero stacks the way 04 does: centered headline and lead, full-width blue and white pills, and the vignette cards below on the yellow band, with a correct small arc. The 'featured' eyebrow sits almost on the arc's lowest point, so the transition is cramped next to the reference's generous white below its bands.

This is a convincing night page: a deep navy ground with indigo cards and vignette chips, a white filter pill with an ink dot, and the yellow hero kept full strength as the one bright field. That is close to 03's navy, where one bright element carries the eye. The footer still ends in a bright white bottom bar, the one light strip on the night page.

This is the same stacked yolk hero on a navy page, with indigo vignette cards, white text and a navy top bar. Night surfaces separate cleanly from the field and the covers keep their full hues, matching the reference's day and night palettes.

A compact yellow header band with a breadcrumb, a bold tight title, meta and white tag pills, then a wide art cluster of about 40% of the band. It shows stacked rounded blocks with darker ledges, a pink disc behind them, two four-point stars and a cloud, so the rc.3 'sticker' gap is closed. The article sits in a prose column beside a cream 'on this page' panel, and related posts use cream cards with flat covers.

The header band follows the compact recipe: the title wraps clear of an 88px corner cluster and the small arc is right. The breadcrumb breaks 'All posts' onto two lines next to the separator, and the cream contents panel butts directly against the arc, so the top is cruder than 04's tidy stack.

This is the yellow header band with the same block cluster over a navy body. Tag pills turn indigo on yellow, and the contents panel, quote and code blocks are indigo. Text contrast and the tone stack are good. The page again ends in a white bottom bar under the indigo footer.

This is the night version of the phone post header, with indigo tags on yellow and an indigo contents panel. It has the same 'All / posts' breadcrumb wrap beside the corner cluster, and the panel starts flush against the arc.

The header-band scene pictures its subject: a blue document with a darker base, a crescent-shaded violet disc cutting into an orange disc, a cloud, and large and small sparkles across about 40% of the band. It is a different silhouette from the other post, so the scene is no longer copied from the spec sample. The body has a cream quote panel, a cream code block and an orange inline figure, at reference-like restraint.

The compact band has a tidy corner pictogram and a two-line bold title, then the cream contents panel. The breadcrumb again splits 'All posts' over two lines, and the panel touches the arc with no breathing room.

The dark appearance of the release-notes post keeps the yellow band and document scene and sets an indigo contents panel on navy, with white body text at a comfortable measure. Hierarchy is as clear as in the reference's night section, where one bright field leads and the content sits on a quiet ground.
This is the night phone header with indigo tag pills on yellow and the corner document cluster. The breadcrumb wrap from the light version repeats, and the contents panel sits flush on the arc.

The about page takes the blue area hue: a white bold title and lead, a white on-field pill, and a wide scene of an open book over a yellow sun with a cloud and pink and white sparkles. It is a subject pictogram at the reference's 02 scale. The body uses small cream spot plates beside section titles and borderless cream author cards with hue initial discs. The plates are smaller and plainer than the 07 pictograms, but the language is right.

The blue band stacks well, with the book cluster tucked in the corner, a wrapped bold title and a white pill. The first section's spot plate and heading start right at the arc's lowest point with no gap, which is tighter than the reference's spacing after a band.

This is the blue band and book scene over navy, with indigo author cards and cream plates that read as small lit discs at night. The footer then ends in the white bottom bar, a bright strip that 03's night palette never has.
This is the night phone about page: the blue band with its corner book cluster, then a cream plate and a white heading on navy. It has the same missing space below the arc as the light phone version.

findings.summary: In dark mode every page still ends in a bright white bottom bar under the indigo footer, the only light strip on a night page. The spec still puts the bar on `surface.inverse`, which is white in the dark table. The reference's night palette (03) stays dark to the edge. Named in rc.3 and unchanged.
findings.promptFix: Give the footer bottom bar its own role token, the darkest surface in both appearances: ink by day, and at night a step darker than the navy page, with white text. Keep `surface.inverse` for small floating pieces such as toasts.
findings.specRule: Footer | Cream band with rise arc, link columns, a signup field + ink pill; `surface.inverse` bottom bar with round icon buttons … (dark) `color.surface.inverse` | `#ffffff`

findings.summary: On phones the post header's breadcrumb is squeezed beside the corner cluster, and its first link wraps word by word: 'All' and 'posts' stack on two lines with the separator floating between them. The reference's compact phone header (04) keeps every line whole.

On phones the first block after a band starts right at the arc's lowest point: the contents panel, the section plate and heading, and the front page's eyebrow. The reference leaves clear white below every band before content begins (02, 12), and the spec asks for `space.12` below the header band.
